purpose: Frame-grounded semantic regression cases. These cases constrain source interpretation and machine timing; they are not a performance-training set and do not authorize outcome-based parameter fitting.

context.claim: A previously descending wick trendline has been broken and is treated as directional structure rather than as an isolated entry signal.

liquidity_or_location.claim: The first return to the broken trendline/nearby prior structure is the area of interest.

interaction.claim: First retest after the break, not breakout chasing.

state_transition.claim: Prior resistance is expected to act as support after the accepted break.

entry.claim: A bullish EasyChart body-engulfing order block overlaps the retest area and supplies executable price geometry.

invalidation.claim: Failure below the shared retest/order-block formation extreme invalidates both the role flip and the entry footprint.

objective.claim: The source-visible planned target must be transcribed from the entry-plan frame before a numeric machine label is accepted.

machine_regression_requirements: The trendline must be based only on pivots observed before the break.
The break must be known before the retest can arm an entry.
The OB is known only after its engulfing candle closes.
No fill is allowed on a touch that occurred before all required evidence was observable.
If OB and trendline imply materially different entry or invalidation geometry, the episode is UNRESOLVED rather than score-ranked.

context.claim: This sequence illustrates how a footprint is used with surrounding structure; it must not be treated as an independently sampled historical trade merely because risk and entry boxes are drawn.

entry.claim: The exact displayed zone geometry is a detector regression target.

invalidation.claim: The displayed formation extreme is a geometry regression target.

objective.claim: The displayed target illustrates planning but is not a realized-outcome label.

machine_regression_requirements: Do not count this educational drawing as an independent completed trade.
Use it to test zone, stop and planned-RR geometry only.
Do not infer a mandatory confluence count from the number of annotations visible on screen.

context.claim: The context frame must be transcribed before assigning a named scenario family.

liquidity_or_location.claim: The setup frame identifies the location selected by the trader; exact source structure and active/stale status require frame-and-transcript reconciliation.

interaction.claim: The setup-to-entry sequence must determine whether this was touch, sweep/reclaim, accepted break/retest, or another state; do not infer from the final result frame.

entry.claim: Use the entry-plan frame, not the later execution screenshot, to determine information available before order submission.

invalidation.claim: Transcribe the originally planned invalidation. Later management annotations are not allowed to rewrite the fixed full-position stop contract.

objective.claim: Transcribe the originally planned single structural objective. Management and result frames are evidence of what happened, not permission to choose a target retrospectively.

machine_regression_requirements: Produce SOURCE_EXPECTATION, MACHINE_TRACE and EXECUTION_TRACE with one causal_event_id.
Separate the pre-entry plan from later management commentary.
Mark any same-bar entry/stop/target order that cannot be established from available data as UNRESOLVED.
Do not use the result frame to select context, entry, stop or target rules.

context.claim: The first frame establishes the larger structure and must be interpreted independently of the later postmortem.

confluence.claim: Annotations may fulfil different roles in one decision; they are not independent votes and not all become mandatory gates.

state_transition.claim: The chronological setup frames determine the executable transition. The postmortem can explain a mistake but cannot create evidence that was unavailable beforehand.

entry.claim: The originally displayed setup defines candidate entry geometry; exact detector mapping remains subject to frame transcription.

invalidation.claim: Use the initially planned structural invalidation, never a hindsight reconstruction from the exit frame.

objective.claim: Use the target frame and ensure it was still active before entry; do not skip a nearer active objective to manufacture more R.

machine_regression_requirements: Classify every visible annotation as core, supporting, explanatory or unused for this episode.
Record the minimum sufficient role set rather than a confluence count.
Distinguish an implementation mismatch from a normal strategy loss in the postmortem.
Preserve the fixed single-entry, fixed-stop, single-target automation contract even if the human video later discusses discretionary management.
